versions.changelog:
- No user-facing changes; version bump only.
- No file changes detected.

- Initial release of baoyu-danger-gemini-web.
- Provides text and image generation using the reverse-engineered Gemini Web API.
- Supports vision input via reference images and multi-turn conversation sessions.
- Implements robust user consent flow before first use, including cross-platform consent file check.
- Allows configuration via project/user-level EXTEND.md files (model, proxy, data dir, etc).
- Includes CLI script for various generation modes, model selection, and session management.
